title: Brian made us smarter
text: Brian was terrific! He showed us around El Born, hitting both major and some minor attractions and giving us the ideal amount of background and context. Brian did a great job of informing us about events from various perspectives, not content to see history as black and white.
author: ChicMama48

title: A great introduction to Barcelona
text: A very nice, personalized and informative tour.  Brian did a great job introducing us to the city and the Catalan culture.
author: Julie_D

title: Unique, Bold, Thoughtful
text: An excellent tour if you wish sincerely to understand not only the city's history, but the people who live therein.
author: Jonathan_P

title: Catalonia History
text: Thank you Brian for your informative tour. The long and complicated history of Catalonia is fascinating.
author: Carrie_B

title: Fabulous tour from a thoroughly engaging tour guide!
text: I don't normally like tours. The forced walking and irksome tour guides tend to turn me off. A friend was keen so I went along and I've got to say, I was very impressed! Had a great time and really enjoyed the experience. The guide, Bryan was a lovely Scottish man who kept things far from dull! I think I may have changed my attitude about these type of tours. Bravo!
author: LucyFireGirl

title: Great tour with Brian
text:
At the end of last summer we did this great tour. For us was very difficult to understand about the Catalan independence and with this tour now we totally get it. 

The places we saw were really nice and helped to understand the city and the political situation.
author: Adam A
